title: Zomato: Missing Items in Food Delivery
customer_persona: Hangry customer who waited 45 minutes for their dinner, only to find the main course missing.
context: Customer ordered a family meal from a premium restaurant via Zomato for Rs 1200. The delivery arrived after 45 minutes, but the main course items (worth Rs 700) are missing from the sealed bag. Customer wants an immediate redelivery or full refund, not just a partial refund coupon.
resolution_path: Apologize + issue instant refund to source for missing items + add Rs 100 goodwill credit

title: AWS: Billing Double Charge on EC2 Upgrades
customer_persona: Professional DevOps engineer. Upgraded their EC2 instances but was charged twice on their corporate credit card.
context: Customer upgraded their AWS account's EC2 instances. Their corporate credit card was charged twice (totaling $3,000 instead of $1,500). Their billing dashboard still shows pending. They have screenshots of the bank SMS. Needs excess charge refunded immediately to avoid accounting issues.
resolution_path: Apologize + manually sync billing dashboard + initiate $1,500 refund trace + escalate to billing team

title: Stripe: API Payment Failed But Money Deducted
customer_persona: Anxious e-commerce store owner using Stripe. A customer tried to pay, the API returned an error, but the customer's bank account was deducted.
context: Store owner reports that their Stripe API integration showed a 'Payment Failed' (HTTP 402) error for a $500 transaction. However, the end-user's bank account was debited. Total $500 deducted but no successful charge on Stripe dashboard. The end-user is threatening the store owner with legal action.
resolution_path: Verify failed intent in logs + confirm it's an authorization hold (will reverse in 3-5 days) + provide official ARN for end-user

title: Vercel: Production Deployment Failing (404)
customer_persona: Stressed frontend developer who pushed a critical hotfix to Vercel, but the production build is resulting in a 404 for all users.
context: Customer deployed a Next.js app to Vercel. The build logs show success, but the production URL returns a 404 error. The site is currently down for 10,000 active users. They are on the Pro plan and demand immediate assistance to rollback or fix the edge caching issue.
resolution_path: Investigate edge network cache + trigger manual rollback + clear CDN cache + explain Next.js routing conflict

title: Swiggy Instamart: Rotten Groceries Delivered
customer_persona: Annoyed customer who ordered fresh groceries via Swiggy Instamart. The fruits delivered are completely rotten and unusable.
context: Customer ordered apples and avocados via Swiggy Instamart for a party. The items delivered are completely rotten, squished, and smell bad. Customer has photos. They are angry about the lack of quality check before packing and want replacement immediately.
resolution_path: Acknowledge poor quality + issue full refund + process free replacement order + log complaint against dark store

title: Cloudflare: Custom Domain SSL Provisioning Stuck
customer_persona: Frustrated tech-savvy user. Trying to host a secure site on Cloudflare but getting security warnings for 24 hours.
context: Customer added their custom domain to Cloudflare. The dashboard has been showing 'Provisioning SSL' for 24 hours. Now when users visit, browsers show a 'Your connection is not private' (ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID) warning. This is their third attempt. Extremely frustrated by the delay.
resolution_path: Acknowledge SSL delay + manually re-trigger Let's Encrypt validation + instruct to purge local DNS cache

title: Uber: Driver Refused Duty and Was Abusive
customer_persona: Furious and shaken passenger whose Uber driver refused to go to the drop location and verbally abused them.
context: Customer booked an Uber at night. The driver arrived, asked for the drop location, and then demanded extra cash. When the customer refused, the driver cancelled the trip, shouted abusive words, and drove away aggressively. Customer felt unsafe and was charged a cancellation fee.
resolution_path: Refund cancellation fee + escalate to trust & safety team + suspend driver pending investigation + apologize sincerely

title: Shopify: Black Friday Discount Code Failing
customer_persona: Panicked Shopify store owner. Their Black Friday discount code is failing for all customers at checkout.
context: Store owner set up a 'BFCM50' discount code for 50% off during Black Friday. Customers are complaining that entering the code at checkout shows 'Discount not applicable'. The store owner is losing hundreds of sales by the minute. Needs urgent fix.
resolution_path: Check discount conditions (e.g. minimum cart value, collection specific) + guide merchant to fix the setting + provide link to Shopify status page
